summary: 18 features and 1 fix across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • scheduled-plans: snapshot declared HagInput text (656ac83)
  • project-prompt-files: support file-backed preset inputs (c1df89f)
  • scheduled-plans: write markdown input snapshots (daccc34)
  • hero-battle-report: add comparisons and project activity (f21d225)

HagiCode-org/web

  • preset-task: preserve file inputs in task requests (f9e3f52)
  • i18n: translate new mobile and report controls (d0d4825)
  • ui: animate toast feedback and refine phone drawers (d5eba2c)
  • wizard: cue newly completed initialization steps (d2c7f05)
  • reports: add daily highlights and section navigation (08362c3)
  • proposal: simplify proposal creation steps on phones (9e486e2)
  • preset-task: add project file inputs and plan support (69d381c)
  • conversation: compact session header on phones (e61410c)
  • settings: add collapsible navigation to phone drawer (4ec9856)
  • achievement: unify daily glyphs and trophy chip styling (744f989)
  • scheduled-plan: expose input file paths for plan entries (9760560)
  • reports: expand daily reports with activity and comparisons (a7eb38f)
  • monospecs: clarify repository cards with cat avatars and zones (111a632)
  • markdown: mark semantic cues in conversation and OpenSpec prose (4c974b6)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • preset-task: keep project file browsing usable in drawers (b2792da)
